definitions.explanation: The table on which table tennis is played, divided by a net across the middle. Built from {卓球|たっきゅう} (table tennis) + {台|だい} (stand; table).

examples.japanese: {体育館|たいいくかん}に{卓球台|たっきゅうだい}を{並|なら}べた。
examples.english: We lined up the table tennis tables in the gym.

examples.japanese: {卓球台|たっきゅうだい}を{折|お}りたたんで{片付|かたづ}けた。
examples.english: We folded up the ping-pong table and put it away.

examples.japanese: {温泉旅館|おんせんりょかん}のロビーに{卓球台|たっきゅうだい}が{置|お}いてあって、{家族|かぞく}で{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: There was a ping-pong table in the lobby of the hot-spring inn, and our family enjoyed it.

notes:
The playing table for table tennis. A folding {卓球台|たっきゅうだい} is a familiar fixture of school gyms and hot-spring inns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卓球台|たっきゅうだい}を{並|なら}べる: to set up table tennis tables
- {折|お}りたたみ{卓球台|たっきゅうだい}: a folding ping-pong table

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {卓球|たっきゅう}: table tennis; ping-pong — the sport itself
- ピンポン: ping-pong — a casual loanword for the game
